description: Native PC port of WCW vs. nWo World Tour (N64) via static recompilation. No game assets included — bring your own ROM.
reasons: native port / recompilation of a commercial game that needs the player's own copy: cannot run in Vapor (not wasm) and must not be hosted; at most a link-only entry in links/ pointing to the original source (see docs/PIPELINE.md)
supply-chain flags: committed-binaries(7+) (read those files before building)
